title: Institution Overview
summary:

title: Instrumentation
summary: The partial document covers several key points about the instrumentation at an observatory, including the Vesper echelle spectrograph with high resolving power, the wide-field camera Lattice with a large field of view, and a robotic patrol telescope used for monitoring transient events.
